Present value at issue of 30 years of lost federal income tax at a 28 percent marginal rate, in the dollars the par is stated in (2014 for the issues from Gayer, Drukker and Gold's Table 3), then in 2026 dollars.
method: with b as (select team, cast(year as integer) as year, issuer_series, cast(par_dollars_year as integer) as par_dollars_year, cast(fed_cost_par_m as double) as counted_par_m, fed_cost_basis from arena_bonds where coalesce(fed_cost_par_m, '') <> '') select f.team, f.arena, f.year, f.issuer_series, f.par_m, b.par_dollars_year, b.counted_par_m, b.fed_cost_basis, f.pv3_30yr_fed_loss_m * b.counted_par_m / f.par_m as pv_m, f.pv3_30yr_fed_loss_m * b.counted_par_m / f.par_m * coalesce((select factor_2026 from cpi where cpi.year = b.par_dollars_year), 1) as pv_2026_m from fed_bond_cost f join b on b.team = f.team and b.year = f.year and b.issuer_series = f.issuer_series where f.tau = 0.28 order by f.year, f.team, f.issuer_series
